title: 微型樁托底補強
summary: 微型樁托底的關鍵不只是把樁打到深處，而是建立既有柱、承台、連接件與地層之間可驗證的新力流。本課逐步檢查鋼材與黏結承載、預載移交、樁群剛度、無側限段挫屈與低淨高接頭，最後用長期沉陷判讀新舊基礎是否確實共同工作。
summaryEn: Micropile underpinning requires a verified new load path from existing columns through caps and connectors into ground. The course examines steel and bond resistance, preloaded transfer, group stiffness, buckling in unsupported zones and low-headroom joints, then interprets long-term settlement to establish interaction between old and new foundations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證」與「鋼材軸應力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification" and "Steel axial stress mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「既有荷載清冊」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Existing-load inventory” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 托底設計須先辨識目前柱力與未來增載，不能把原設計圖的基礎反力直接當成現況。使用變更、加建及設備集中載重會改變分配，施工期間的臨時支承也需單獨列出，才能決定新樁要接管多少力與何時接管。直接相加只描述本例同時服務荷載，沒有套用設計分項係數；不同作用組合及既有基礎可分擔比例需另行建立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「既有荷載清冊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underpinning starts with current column forces and future additions rather than assuming original foundation reactions still apply. Changes of use, extensions and concentrated equipment alter load distribution, and temporary support requires a separate case. These distinctions determine how much load new piles must take and when transfer occurs. Direct addition describes simultaneous service loads in this example only; design factors, combinations and the share retained by existing foundations require separate definition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Existing-load inventory” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，服務荷載合計P=800+250+150=1200 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For existing column force 800 kN, extension 250 kN and equipment 150 kN, combined service load P=1200 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「既有荷載清冊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Existing-load inventory”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 托底設計須先辨識目前柱力與未來增載，不能把原設計圖的基礎反力直接當成現況。使用變更、加建及設備集中載重會改變分配，施工期間的臨時支承也需單獨列出，才能決定新樁要接管多少力與何時接管。
knowledge.textEn: Underpinning starts with current column forces and future additions rather than assuming original foundation reactions still apply. Changes of use, extensions and concentrated equipment alter load distribution, and temporary support requires a separate case.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「微型樁托底補強」的「既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「地下水與沉陷觀測室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths” in “Micropile underpinning”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Groundwater and settlement observatory” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。
托底設計須先辨識目前柱力與未來增載，不能把原設計圖的基礎反力直接當成現況。
微型樁平均鋼應力不高，就不用檢查接頭與局部挫屈。
optionsEn: New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant.
Underpinning starts with current column forces and future additions rather than assuming original foundation reactions still apply.
Low mean steel stress removes the need for connection and local-buckling checks.
quiz.explanation: 托底設計須先辨識目前柱力與未來增載，不能把原設計圖的基礎反力直接當成現況。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Underpinning starts with current column forces and future additions rather than assuming original foundation reactions still apply. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「既有荷載清冊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Existing-load inventory” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，服務荷載合計P=800+250+150=1200 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For existing column force 800 kN, extension 250 kN and equipment 150 kN, combined service load P=1200 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對現況尺寸、使用荷載及裂縫沉陷紀錄，將不同時期荷載分列，與上部結構模型交叉核查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check existing dimensions, imposed loads and cracking-settlement records, separating load stages and cross-checking them against the superstructure model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，服務荷載合計P=800+250+150=1200 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For existing column force 800 kN, extension 250 kN and equipment 150 kN, combined service load P=1200 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 微型樁試驗合格就代表與舊基礎的連接也合格。
同一承台下所有微型樁一定平均分擔柱力。
原創教學假設：假設現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，服務荷載合計P=800+250+150=1200 kN。
optionsEn: A successful micropile load test proves the old-foundation connection is adequate.
Every micropile under one cap necessarily shares column load equally.
Original teaching assumptions: For existing column force 800 kN, extension 250 kN and equipment 150 kN, combined service load P=1200 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，服務荷載合計P=800+250+150=1200 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For existing column force 800 kN, extension 250 kN and equipment 150 kN, combined service load P=1200 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「既有荷載清冊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Existing-load inventory” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對現況尺寸、使用荷載及裂縫沉陷紀錄，將不同時期荷載分列，與上部結構模型交叉核查。荷載清冊應由上部結構與基礎設計者共同簽認；施工階段和最終使用階段不可混用未標示的力值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check existing dimensions, imposed loads and cracking-settlement records, separating load stages and cross-checking them against the superstructure model. Superstructure and foundation designers jointly sign the load inventory; construction and final-use forces must not be mixed without explicit stage labels. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：荷載清冊應由上部結構與基礎設計者共同簽認；施工階段和最終使用階段不可混用未標示的力值。直接相加只描述本例同時服務荷載，沒有套用設計分項係數；不同作用組合及既有基礎可分擔比例需另行建立。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Superstructure and foundation designers jointly sign the load inventory; construction and final-use forces must not be mixed without explicit stage labels. Direct addition describes simultaneous service loads in this example only; design factors, combinations and the share retained by existing foundations require separate definition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏列新增設備或移除原支承，會使微型樁承擔超出假設的荷載，造成移交後持續沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted equipment loads or removed original support can impose more load than assumed, causing continued settlement after transfer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對現況尺寸、使用荷載及裂縫沉陷紀錄，將不同時期荷載分列，與上部結構模型交叉核查。荷載清冊應由上部結構與基礎設計者共同簽認；施工階段和最終使用階段不可混用未標示的力值。
knowledge.textEn: Check existing dimensions, imposed loads and cracking-settlement records, separating load stages and cross-checking them against the superstructure model. Superstructure and foundation designers jointly sign the load inventory; construction and final-use forces must not be mixed without explicit stage labels.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 荷載清冊應由上部結構與基礎設計者共同簽認；施工階段和最終使用階段不可混用未標示的力值。直接相加只描述本例同時服務荷載，沒有套用設計分項係數；不同作用組合及既有基礎可分擔比例需另行建立。
knowledge.textEn: Superstructure and foundation designers jointly sign the load inventory; construction and final-use forces must not be mixed without explicit stage labels. Direct addition describes simultaneous service loads in this example only; design factors, combinations and the share retained by existing foundations require separate definition.

quiz.question: 要驗證「既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification"?
options: 核對現況尺寸、使用荷載及裂縫沉陷紀錄，將不同時期荷載分列，與上部結構模型交叉核查。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
柱力是向下的，就不可能讓任何托底樁受到拉力。
optionsEn: Check existing dimensions, imposed loads and cracking-settlement records, separating load stages and cross-checking them against the superstructure model.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension.
quiz.explanation: 核對現況尺寸、使用荷載及裂縫沉陷紀錄，將不同時期荷載分列，與上部結構模型交叉核查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check existing dimensions, imposed loads and cracking-settlement records, separating load stages and cross-checking them against the superstructure model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「既有荷載清冊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Existing-load inventory” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏列新增設備或移除原支承，會使微型樁承擔超出假設的荷載，造成移交後持續沉陷。直接相加只描述本例同時服務荷載，沒有套用設計分項係數；不同作用組合及既有基礎可分擔比例需另行建立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted equipment loads or removed original support can impose more load than assumed, causing continued settlement after transfer. Direct addition describes simultaneous service loads in this example only; design factors, combinations and the share retained by existing foundations require separate definition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：直接相加只描述本例同時服務荷載，沒有套用設計分項係數；不同作用組合及既有基礎可分擔比例需另行建立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Direct addition describes simultaneous service loads in this example only; design factors, combinations and the share retained by existing foundations require separate definition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏列新增設備或移除原支承，會使微型樁承擔超出假設的荷載，造成移交後持續沉陷。直接相加只描述本例同時服務荷載，沒有套用設計分項係數；不同作用組合及既有基礎可分擔比例需另行建立。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted equipment loads or removed original support can impose more load than assumed, causing continued settlement after transfer. Direct addition describes simultaneous service loads in this example only; design factors, combinations and the share retained by existing foundations require separate definition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
漏列新增設備或移除原支承，會使微型樁承擔超出假設的荷載，造成移交後持續沉陷。
微型樁平均鋼應力不高，就不用檢查接頭與局部挫屈。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Omitted equipment loads or removed original support can impose more load than assumed, causing continued settlement after transfer.
Low mean steel stress removes the need for connection and local-buckling checks.
quiz.explanation: 漏列新增設備或移除原支承，會使微型樁承擔超出假設的荷載，造成移交後持續沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted equipment loads or removed original support can impose more load than assumed, causing continued settlement after transfer. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼材軸應力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel axial stress mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼材軸應力」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel axial stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 微型樁的鋼套管或鋼筋與水泥漿共同傳遞軸力，鋼材分擔比例取決於剛度及接頭連續性。先把全部力分配給鋼材可作特定保守假設，但不代表漿體永遠不參與；腐蝕餘量、套管接頭與局部挫屈也不能靠平均應力取代。這是指定分力下的平均應力，不是微型樁整體承載力；鋼材、漿體、連接及地層黏結需依相容荷載路徑分別檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼材軸應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel casing or bars share axial force with grout according to stiffness and continuity. Assigning all force to steel may be a specified conservative assumption, but does not imply grout never participates. Corrosion allowance, casing joints and local buckling also require checks beyond an average axial stress. This is mean stress under an assigned force, not total micropile capacity; steel, grout, connections and ground bond require separate checks on a compatible load path. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steel axial stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設鋼材獨自承受P=600 kN、有效鋼面積As=0.004 m²，σs=P/As=150 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: If steel alone carries P=600 kN over effective area As=0.004 m², σs=P/As=150 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「微型樁平均鋼應力不高，就不用檢查接頭與局部挫屈。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low mean steel stress removes the need for connection and local-buckling checks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼材軸應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Steel axial stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼材軸應力的機理與驗證

knowledge.textEn: Steel casing or bars share axial force with grout according to stiffness and continuity. Assigning all force to steel may be a specified conservative assumption, but does not imply grout never participates.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：微型樁平均鋼應力不高，就不用檢查接頭與局部挫屈。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low mean steel stress removes the need for connection and local-buckling checks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼材軸應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 微型樁平均鋼應力不高，就不用檢查接頭與局部挫屈。

微型樁的鋼套管或鋼筋與水泥漿共同傳遞軸力，鋼材分擔比例取決於剛度及接頭連續性。
optionsEn: Low mean steel stress removes the need for connection and local-buckling checks.
High grout volume necessarily creates a larger continuous bond diameter.

steps.title: 鋼材軸應力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel axial stress mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼材軸應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel axial stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設鋼材獨自承受P=600 kN、有效鋼面積As=0.004 m²，σs=P/As=150 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: If steel alone carries P=600 kN over effective area As=0.004 m², σs=P/As=150 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對鋼材證書、實際壁厚與接頭型式，將載重試驗應變比較鋼漿共同作用假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify steel certificates, actual thickness and connection type, comparing load-test strains with the assumed steel-grout composite action.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鋼材軸應力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel axial stress mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼材軸應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel axial stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對鋼材證書、實際壁厚與接頭型式，將載重試驗應變比較鋼漿共同作用假設。竣工資料需保留鋼材批號、套管長度及接頭位置；結構設計者確認有效截面後才能接受材料替代。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify steel certificates, actual thickness and connection type, comparing load-test strains with the assumed steel-grout composite action. Retain steel batches, casing lengths and joint positions; the structural designer confirms effective sections before accepting material substitutions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工資料需保留鋼材批號、套管長度及接頭位置；結構設計者確認有效截面後才能接受材料替代。這是指定分力下的平均應力，不是微型樁整體承載力；鋼材、漿體、連接及地層黏結需依相容荷載路徑分別檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain steel batches, casing lengths and joint positions; the structural designer confirms effective sections before accepting material substitutions. This is mean stress under an assigned force, not total micropile capacity; steel, grout, connections and ground bond require separate checks on a compatible load path.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把名目壁厚當有效面積可能忽略腐蝕或螺紋減弱，接頭也可能先於完整鋼管失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using nominal thickness can ignore corrosion or thread reductions, and connections may fail before an intact casing section. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
